subject: Random Dungeon A
text: Random Dungeon A room 3 contains rocks to grab.

evidence.quote: Grab the rocks and kill what you must.

subject: Random Dungeon B
text: Random Dungeon B room 2 contains rocks.

evidence.quote: There are four boars here, and there are some rocks.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: Random Dungeon C room 2 contains rocks.

evidence.quote: There are two boars here, and there are some rocks.

subject: Random Dungeon C
text: Random Dungeon C room 3 has no enemies and contains hearts to collect.

evidence.quote: There are no enemies here. Just hearts to collect.

subject: Blue bear
text: Killing the blue bear in Random Dungeon C room 4 with stones opens the path to Room 5.

evidence.quote: Quickly kill him with your...stones and the path will open up to ROOM #5.

subject: Ice Age snow holes
text: Holes in the Ice Age snow appear randomly, so expect to fall into some while crossing.

evidence.quote: As far as I can tell these holes are random so just be prepared to fall into a few of them as you cross this snow.

subject: Cave Men Cave
text: Tink, by a large pile of bones in Cave Men Cave, gives Mike an Axe he made.

evidence.quote: visit Tink over by a large pile of bones. He has an Axe

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: Room 4 of Yum Yum Cave contains a medicine item.

evidence.quote: There is nothing here but a medicine. Just take it and go back to

subject: Yum Yum Cave room 9
text: Defeating the three blue bears in room 9 opens the north door to Room 11.

evidence.quote: [-- 11 --] ... ROOM #9: There are three blue bears that you need to defeat to open the door to the North.

subject: Yum Yum Cave room 13
text: Defeating the three yellow bears in room 13 opens the door to the room 14 maze.

evidence.quote: ROOM #13: This room has three yellow bears. In this room you must defeat them to open the door to the North taking you to ROOM #14.

subject: Yum Yum Cave maze
object: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle
text: The room 14 maze is solved by following the symbol sequence circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle, taking the exit closest to each symbol.

evidence.quote: ROOM #14: ... If you didn't write it down it was: circle, circle, triangle, square, circle, square, triangle.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Yum Yum goes down after about 30 axes thrown at him, which opens the east door to Room 18.

evidence.quote: down after about 30 axes and the door to the East and Room #18 will

subject: Yum Yum
text: Throwing axes at Yum Yum immediately after entering room 17 should let you kill him before he attacks.

evidence.quote: ROOM #17 BOSS FIGHT: (YUM YUM) ... If you start throwing axes at him immediately you should be able to kill him before he gets one shot off.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Killing the boar beside Yum Yum makes him engage in combat immediately.

evidence.quote: but if you kill this boar he will immediately engage you in combat.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Avoid the bubbles Yum Yum burps at you during the fight.

evidence.quote: bubbles he burps at you and keep throwing axes his way.

subject: Yum Yum Cave room 18
text: Room 18 has an exit to the north.

evidence.quote: Room #18: There is an exit to the North.

subject: Yum Yum Cave
text: The Block Mike picks up in Yum Yum Cave is a Tetrad.

evidence.quote: Block he just picked up in the cave is one of these

subject: Yum Yum Cave tetrad
text: Obtaining the Yum Yum Cave tetrad raises Mike's life total to seven hearts.

evidence.quote: As a bonus you increase your life total to seven hearts.

subject: Pikazo's wall drawings
text: The guide says to visit Pikazo and write down the drawings on his wall in Cave Men Cave.

evidence.quote: visit Pikazo and write down the drawings you see on his wall.

subject: Yum Yum
text: Yum Yum will eat the boar next to him and continue to ignore you.
